claims.statement: SC students Class 11 to PhD with family income ≤ ₹2.5 lakh/year are eligible for the Post‑Matric Scholarship (SC).
claims.quote: Post-Matric Scholarship (SC)SC students Class 11 to PhD; family income ≤ ₹2.5 lakh/year₹7,000–₹36,200

claims.statement: Required documents include Aadhaar card, current income certificate (2025‑26 or 2026), caste/community certificate, previous year marksheet, enrollment certificate and bank passbook.
claims.quote: Documents Required for NSP Scholarship 2026-27 DocumentPurposeValidity Required Aadhaar CardIdentity + DBT bank linkingCurrent / valid Income CertificateFamily income proof (below threshold)Issued in 2025-26 or 2026 Caste / Community CertificateSC/ST/OBC/Minority eligibility proofPermanent / current year Previous Year MarksheetAcademic eligibilityLatest available year Bonafide / Enrollment CertificateProof of current enrollment in institutionCurrent academic year 2026-27 Bank Passbook (student's own account)Scholarship DBT paymentAadhaar-linked, active account

claims.statement: Application last date for fresh 2026‑27 applications is 31 October 2026.
claims.quote: Application Last Date: October 31, 2026 (typically — check scholarships.gov.in for exact date)

claims.statement: Institute verification deadline is approximately 15 November 2026.
Fresh applications open in mid‑July 2026 and run until October 2026.
Renewal applications open in the first week of July 2026.
claims.quote: Renewal Applications Open: First week of July 2026

claims.statement: Scholarship funds are transferred directly to the student’s Aadhaar‑linked bank account via DBT.
claims.quote: All payments directly to your bank account via DBT — no middlemen or agents needed.

claims.statement: If payment fails, it is usually because the bank account is not Aadhaar‑linked.
claims.quote: If showing "Payment Failed" or "DBT Failed," your bank account is not Aadhaar-linked — visit your bank to complete Aadhaar seeding (NPCI linking).

claims.statement: Step‑by‑step: register on scholarships.gov.in, verify mobile OTP, create login, fill personal, academic, income and bank details, upload documents, and submit for institute verification.
claims.quote: Create NSP account (fresh applicants): Visit scholarships.gov.in → Click "New Registration" → Select your state and scholarship type → Fill in your basic details → Mobile OTP verification → Create login ID and password. Login and fill application form: Login with your credentials → Select the correct scholarship (e.g., Post-Matric SC Scholarship) → Fill all sections: personal details, academic details, parent/income details, bank details. Upload documents: Upload scanned copies of all required documents (listed below).

claims.statement: Maximum scholarship amount is ₹36,200 per year for post‑matric hostellers; amounts range from ₹10,000 to ₹36,200 per year.
claims.quote: Maximum Amount: ₹36,200/year (post-matric hostellers)Official Portal: scholarships.gov.inHelpline: 0120-6619540Payment Mode: Direct to student's bank account

claims.statement: Applying for NSP scholarships is completely free; there are no application fees.
claims.quote: Unlike many government schemes, NSP scholarships are completely free to apply and the money goes directly to your bank account via DBT — no middlemen or agents needed.

claims.statement: Renewal applicants must log in, click "Renew Application", update details and submit before the fresh‑applicant deadline; early deadline is end of August.
claims.quote: Renewal applicants must apply before fresh applicants' deadline. You do NOT fill a new form — just login and click "Renew Application" then update your current academic year details. Renewal applications usually have an earlier deadline than fresh applications — submit by end of August to be safe.

claims.statement: Renewal applications open in the first week of July 2026, earlier than fresh applications.
claims.quote: Renewal applications for continuing students open even earlier — check scholarships.gov.in from the first week of July.

claims.statement: Helpline number is 0120‑6619540 (Mon‑Fri, 10 AM‑6 PM) and grievances can be filed via the "Grievance" section on scholarships.gov.in.
claims.quote: Helpline: 0120-6619540 (Monday–Friday, 10 AM–6 PM) 🌐 Official Portal: scholarships.gov.in 🌐 Grievance: pgportal.gov.in → Education Department

claims.statement: For ministry‑specific scholarships, contact the respective ministry helpdesk (e.g., Ministry of Social Justice or Ministry of Minority Affairs).
claims.quote: Also contact the respective ministry helpdesk (Ministry of Social Justice for SC/OBC scholarships, Ministry of Minority Affairs for minority scholarships).
